line: Golly, you look like a proper hero, my friend! I want to be one too.

thought: offers a flower then remembers they're spoken for
line: Have a flower! No, wait, they're for... somebody. Have a sniff, then.

thought: kind face; would confide if he could remember
line: Kind face! I'd tell you my troubles if I could remember them.

thought: says they're lovely, as he does to all
line: You're lovely! Sorry, I say that to everyone, but you are!

thought: thinks he knows them
line: Oh, it's you! At least I think it's you. Hello anyway, my friend!

thought: they'd suit flowers
line: You'd look smashing with a bunch of flowers, my friend.

thought: would copy them if he became a hero
line: If I ever become a hero, I'll copy you exactly, my friend.

thought: someone nice in a grumpy city
line: Wooooo! Someone nice! Varrock's full of grumpy people.

thought: mistook them for someone important
line: From behind I thought you were someone important. Sorry, my friend!

thought: they look battered, like balcony victims
line: Did something fall on you off a balcony? Things do, you know.

thought: they look summons-prone, like him
line: You look the sort who gets court summonses. I get them too!

thought: they look tired, as from sermons
line: Golly, you look tired. Father Lawrence's sermons do that to people.

thought: neither will be heroes; solidarity
line: You'd never be a hero, would you? Me neither! Shake hands?

thought: a forgettable face, though he forgets all
line: Have we met? You've a very forgettable face. Not that I remember any.

thought: this one looks as lost as he is
line: Looks as lost as I am, that one. That's quite lost.

thought: nobody says hello first except him
line: Nobody in Varrock ever says hello first. Except me. And not this one.

thought: muddles the priest's name again
line: Lather... no. Father Lawrence. Why do I always get that one wrong?

thought: wandering, forgets where to
line: The square, then the general store, then... where was I going?

thought: flowers for someone he can't recall
line: These flowers were for somebody. Lovely somebody. Ermmm...

thought: a message is always a summons
line: A message? No, a court summons. They always are.

thought: wants to be a hero; heroes should get flowers
line: I always wanted to be a hero. Do heroes get flowers? They should.

thought: slept through the sermons
line: Father Lawrence's sermons... I slept through the last two, I think.

thought: thinks he went to school with Lawrence
line: I went to school with Father Lawrence. Or someone very like him.

thought: talks first to a stranger
line: Hello! You won't mind if I talk at you a bit? Nobody else stops.

thought: a messenger's face
line: You've the face of someone who carries messages. A good face!

thought: brave enough to face a father
line: Golly, you look brave! Brave enough to talk to a lady's father, even.

thought: they'd understand love, he thinks
line: You'd understand love, I can tell. Do you? I can't tell, actually.

thought: nearly as lovely as Juliet
line: You're nearly as lovely as Juliet! Not quite. Close, though.

thought: Juliet likes everyone but him
line: Juliet would like you. She likes everyone. Except me, some days.

thought: a friend; friends help with things
line: A friend! I need friends. Friends help with... ermmm... things.

thought: they walk like a hero; he walks like a florist
line: That one walks like a hero. I walk like a man carrying flowers.

thought: lucky in love, unlike him
line: You've a lucky look about you, my friend. Lucky in love, I bet.

thought: disappointed they're not Juliet
line: Oh. You're not Juliet. Never mind, you're still... somebody.

thought: fears they're the father
line: Are you her father? You're not, are you? You look cross enough.

thought: Juliet would throw things at them too
line: Golly, if Juliet saw that one she'd throw something.

thought: they look lonely, less than him
line: Lonely, are you, my friend? Not as lonely as me, but lonely.

thought: neither could climb a balcony
line: You'd never get up a balcony. Neither could I. We're alike!

thought: not much help, nor is he
line: Not much help, are you? Never mind. Nor am I.

thought: they look like a summons
line: You look like a court summons, my friend. Official and frightening.

thought: nobody's in love but him
line: Nobody's in love round here except me. Not even that one.

thought: unsure of her name
line: Her name's Juliet, I'm almost sure. It begins with a J, anyway.

thought: her father forbids them; can't recall him
line: Her father won't let us meet. Her father! Whoever he is.

thought: she's in the west; he's been there once
line: She lives on the west side of the city. I've been there! Once.

thought: would sing again but she throws things
line: I'd sing up to her balcony again, but she throws things.

thought: wishes for a messenger
line: If only someone would carry her a message. A nice one, not a summons.

thought: waiting in the square for love
line: I'll wait in the square. Love waits in squares, I think.

thought: flowers will come back at him
line: Flowers for Juliet again. She'll throw them back. She's a good arm.

thought: heart west, feet in the square
line: My heart's in the west of the city and my feet are in the square.

thought: they're helping him, he thinks
line: You're helping me, aren't you? Golly! I think you are!

thought: his messenger; forgot the name
line: My dearest, bravest messenger! What was your name again?

thought: they'd walk past her father
line: You're braver than me. You'd walk right past her father!

thought: they might make him a hero
line: If I ever become a hero, it'll be your fault. In a good way!

thought: back, or new; either way wonderful
line: Wooooo! You came back! Or you're new. Either way, wonderful!

thought: they don't look like a father
line: You've not got a face like a father. That's the nicest thing I know.

thought: muddles friend and love
line: There goes a friend in love. A friend to love. A friend, anyway.

thought: Juliet's lucky to have them both
line: Juliet's lucky to have us. Well, me. And you, for the moment.

thought: a stern look; might be the father
line: Wait, are you her father? You're not? Then why the stern look?

thought: someone is late; unsure who
line: You took your time! Or I did. One of us is late, my friend.

thought: they look grim; wants good news
line: Golly, you look grim. Bring good news next time, not that face.

thought: a slow messenger
line: You don't run very fast for a messenger, do you, my friend?

thought: wants nothing to do with potions
line: Potions and I don't agree. Somebody else can drink that sort of thing.

thought: they look like a father; stand off
line: You look a bit like a father. Any father. Do stand further off.

thought: they forgot the message, as he would
line: Did you forget the message? I'd forget the message. We're so alike!

thought: unsure whose side this one is on
line: Is that one on my side or her father's? Hard to say. Shifty.

thought: any man could be her father
line: Every man in Varrock could be her father. Every single one!

thought: spots a man, panics, decides baker
line: Is that him? Is that her father? No... a baker. Probably.

thought: sworn to be killed by someone unknown
line: Her father's sworn to kill me. I'd hide, if I knew who from.

thought: didn't follow the potion plan
line: A potion to make her look... ermmm. I didn't follow that bit.

thought: keeping out of the west side
line: I'm keeping out of sight. Well, out of the west side. Mostly.

thought: a disguise he'd forget
line: Should I wear a disguise? I'd only forget I was wearing it.

thought: hid from a stern man behind flowers
line: A stern-looking man went by, so I hid behind my flowers. Golly.

thought: fathers make love hard
line: Love's easy. It's the fathers that make it hard.
